bio_paragraphs: I'm an IT student and aspiring software engineer focused on full-stack development and AI integration. I build web and mobile applications that solve practical problems through business process automation, workflow systems, and offline-first technologies.

My projects include eBPLS, a business permitting and licensing system designed to streamline government workflows, and HanapMedisina, an offline-first mobile app that uses an on-device AI model to identify Philippine medicinal plants. Through these projects, I've gained hands-on experience in system architecture, REST API development, database design, authentication, and mobile application development.

I enjoy turning real-world problems into practical, reliable software. I'm continuously improving my skills in software engineering, AI integration, and scalable system design, with the goal of building user-focused solutions that create meaningful impact.
